LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Train_Blow: {OTHER_nameDef}'s blow at training landed for real: {PAWN_nameDef} is hurt on the {PART}.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Train_Status1: {X_nameDef} has trained {HOURS} of {TARGET} hours so far, {TODAY} of {DAILY} today. They train in the evenings when {TEACHER} is free.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Wedding_NotReady: There is no {THING} of good quality or better at the colony yet.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Wedding_NotReadyPacked: There is no {THING} of good quality or better packed up (uninstalled) at the colony yet.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Sick_Coming: {DROVER} of {FACTION} is bringing their sick animal, {NAME}, to the colony's gate.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Sick_Well: {NAME} is well again. {FACTION}'s drover will come for it.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Sick_Status2: {NAME} is still sick with {ILLNESS}. Keep it fed, and have a doctor treat it when it needs it.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Sick_StatusTend: {NAME} is sick with {ILLNESS} and needs a doctor to treat it now.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Camp_Status0: {NAME} and the others, {COUNT} in all, will come in the late afternoon and camp at the {WAY} edge.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Camp_Status1: {FACTION}'s people are camped at the {WAY} edge of the colony's land.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Camp_Raiders: Raiders of {ENEMY} are attacking {FACTION}'s camp at the {WAY} edge of the colony's land. {FACTION}'s people are up and ready to fight, and the colony agreed to keep watch over them.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Camp_Beast: A wild {THING} is attacking {FACTION}'s camp at the {WAY} edge of the colony's land, going after people. {FACTION}'s people are up and ready to fight, and the colony agreed to keep watch over them.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Camp_Beasts: Wild {THING} are attacking {FACTION}'s camp at the {WAY} edge of the colony's land, going after people. {FACTION}'s people are up and ready to fight, and the colony agreed to keep watch over them.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Seed_Warm: {FACTION}'s seed ({ITEM}) is warmer than freezing where it lies. It has to be kept in {STORE} at freezing or colder; after more than {MAX} warm hours in all it is no good as seed.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Seed_StatusOut: The sowing is near: one of the colony's people will carry the seed out of the cold store for {FACTION}'s carts.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Seed_Status2: {FACTION}'s carts are coming for their seed.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Seed_Cold: Where it lies it is {TEMP}, cold enough.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Seed_NotCold: Where it lies it is {TEMP}, warmer than freezing.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Seed_NotForbidden: It is not forbidden, so someone may use it.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Book_stories: a book of their people's stories
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Copy_Status1: Copied so far: {HOURS} of {TARGET} hours of work at a research bench.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Music_Status0: {NAME} and the others, {COUNT} in all, will come in the afternoon.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Music_Status1: They will play at a party in the evening, from {HOUR}:00.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Music_Status2: They are playing at the colony's party.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Music_Status2NoParty: There is no party tonight, so they are playing for whoever comes.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Music_Status3: They are staying the night and will leave in the morning.
LanguageData.CC_HomeQ2_Music_NoBed: One of them had no bed.
